name: ava-workbuddy-assistant
description: Explore files, databases, inline data and Feishu/Lark Bitable with AVA. Answer questions with verified results, visualizations and traceable reports.

displayDescription.zh: 分析文件、数据库、飞书表格等数据源，探索数据特征、回答业务问题，交付结论、图表和可追溯的报告。
displayDescription.en: Explore files, databases, inline data and Feishu/Lark Bitable. Answer business questions and deliver findings, result tables, interactive charts and traceable reports.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 分析我提供的数据，概括主要特征、值得关注的问题和可继续探索的方向。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Explore the data I provide, summarize its main characteristics, and identify noteworthy issues and useful follow-up questions.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析我提供的数据，概括主要特征、值得关注的问题和可继续探索的方向。
quickPrompts.en: Explore the data I provide, summarize its main characteristics, and identify noteworthy issues and useful follow-up questions.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析数据库中的业务数据，比较不同时期或类别的差异，并用图表解释关键发现。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze business data in my database, compare periods or categories, and explain the key findings with charts.

quickPrompts.zh: 分析这张飞书多维表格，回答我的问题，并生成包含结论、图表和查询依据的报告。
quickPrompts.en: Analyze this Feishu/Lark Bitable, answer my questions, and create a report with findings, charts and query evidence.
